visual.general_description: Composite of four lettered color clinical photograph panels showing facial, ear, limb, trunk and hand skin lesions.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A, left, is a frontal face photograph with masked eyes and many raised pink-red to violaceous nodules and plaques. Panel B, upper right, groups close-ups of skin, lower leg and ankle, and both hands with scattered lesions. Panel C, lower left, shows an ear with a black arrow and the back of a hand. Panel D, lower middle and right, shows an ear with a black arrow and an eyebrow region close-up with a black oval mask over the eye and a black arrow.

panels.general_description: Color frontal photograph of a face with separate black oval masks over both eyes and many raised skin nodules.
panels.detailed_description: Frontal close-up of the face and upper neck, with a separate black oval mask over each eye. Numerous raised, rounded to oval pink-red and violaceous nodules and plaques are scattered over the forehead, cheeks, nose, chin and around the mouth, with thickened skin and deep creases over the cheeks and nasolabial folds. Both ears are visible with similar raised bumps. Dark short hair, a dark collar and a gray background are visible. No arrow or text label other than the panel letter is visible.

visual.general_description: Color microscopy image of stained skin tissue with granule-filled cells, two arrowheads and the printed label “L.D bodies”.
visual.detailed_description: Brightfield-style stained tissue field in purple, pink and pale yellow tones. Large pale vacuolated cells contain numerous tiny round dark purple granules packed in clusters. Scattered darker oval nuclei and a few small red cells are visible. Two black arrowheads point to cell regions containing the granules and the printed text “L.D bodies” appears in black between them. No scale bar or magnification is visible.
